problem_statement: In the mdspan-based Kokkos::View implementation, constructing a subview via Kokkos::subview does not validate slice arguments against the source view extents. Add bounds checking that is active only when KOKKOS_ENABLE_DEBUG_BOUNDS_CHECK is defined. For each dimension: an integer index must be less than the source extent; a std::pair<T,T> or Kokkos::pair<T,T> range must satisfy 0 <= first <= second <= extent; Kokkos::ALL is always valid. If any slice violates these rules, abort with a message containing 'Kokkos::subview bounds error'. When KOKKOS_ENABLE_DEBUG_BOUNDS_CHECK is not enabled, behavior must remain unchanged.
title: Check subview extents in mdspan-based View implementation
